title: DeviceReportingRelationship
description: D7 (docs/ontology/DECISIONS.md), Option B: a device's primitive name (e.g. temp_mech_room) is its short identity -- primary measurement + location -- not an exhaustive list of what it reports. This schema is the explicit, separate fact Option B introduces: one row per measurement type a device actually reports, distinct from the device's own name/identity. Sprint 1 stub -- formalizes a relationship that already exists at runtime (CabinEventService.reportedFieldsByDevice(), shipped 2026-08-27) but is not yet a persisted, queryable entity; see DECISIONS.md's D7 status note for the production bug that motivated replacing a static per-type guess with this kind of explicit, provenanced fact.

device_entity_id.description: D1: the device's snake_case entity_id -- the canonical identity this relationship attaches to. Not a foreign key in this stub yet; Sprint 1's repository class is what gives this real referential integrity against the `device` table.

measurement_type.description: The physical quantity this relationship describes. Deliberately closed today, not open -- extend only when a real new measurement type is onboarded (matching cabin-3rd-party-device-onboarding's own discipline), not speculatively.

semantic_field.description: The normalized CabinEvent payload key this measurement type is stored under -- must match WorkflowRuleService's own field vocabulary (temperature/humidity/co2/co/airQualityIndex) exactly, so this schema and the running engine can never silently disagree about what a field is called. Deliberately a free string, not an enum mirroring measurement_type 1:1 -- the two are usually the same word but aren't guaranteed to be (air_quality_index -> airQualityIndex casing difference already exists).

confirmation_source.description: D4's provenance mixin, applied to this Definition-layer fact. 'empirical_observation' is what CabinEventService.reportedFieldsByDevice() already provides in production today -- confirmed by real logged data, not a guess. 'type_inferred' is the older, sometimes-wrong DeviceType.telemetryFields() static guess this relationship replaces as the actual source of truth (kept as a valid value so a not-yet-observed device can still get a provisional answer). 'vendor_spec' and 'manual_override' are the two additional sources a separate, not-yet-built proposal describes (multiple competing user-selectable device definitions with provenance) -- not wired to any UI yet, but the schema already has room for them so that work doesn't need a breaking schema change later.

confirmed_at.description: Axiom: time is primary on every fact. When this relationship was last confirmed true, not just when the row was first created -- lets a stale empirical_observation (a device that's gone quiet) be told apart from a fresh one.

location.description: D6: Location is first-class from day one; defaults to cabin if omitted. Present here because a reporting relationship, not just the device itself, is meaningfully scoped to where the device physically is.
